versions.changelog:
- Updated usage instructions to clarify that users can paste the diff or run the git diff --cached --stat command
- Minor edit: simplified "When to Use" 
- No functionality changes; documentation and instruction improvements only

- Added new sections to SKILL.md: Description, License or terms, Use case, Risks and mitigations, References, and Ethical considerations
- Included a Git documentation reference in SKILL.md
- Clarified legal and ethical restrictions on usage in SKILL.md

- Initial release of git-commit-message-helper.
- Suggests conventional-commit messages from a staged diff summary.
- Guides the user to provide diff/stat info if not given.
- Outputs a primary commit message and two alternatives.
- Requires git if running commands; does not commit or push code.
